title: Hand off to the next agent or chat
purpose: Produce a compact continuation record that lets the receiver re-enter without trusting stale chat memory.
steps: Refresh branch, HEAD, PR, and dirty-state evidence.
List files changed and validators actually run with exits.
Name generated artifact paths and state that they are local/untracked.
State what is verified, what remains unproved, and the exact blocker if any.

Provide one copy-paste next command that resolves repository location safely, verifies the exact remote ref/SHA, preserves dirty work using an isolated worktree, runs the owning validator, resolves the canonical operator artifact, and propagates nonzero exits.
Require the receiver to re-inspect current state before mutating.
proofCeiling: Continuation metadata; never continuing authority by itself.
